description: Implementation of TTSDownloader class handling text-to-speech file download via HTTP using libcurl, with threading and configuration management.

classes.name: TTSDownloader
classes.description: Handles downloading TTS files, managing download threads, and saving fallback configurations.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Starts a new download thread with the provided configuration.

methods.name: downloadThread
methods.description: Main loop for performing downloads, retries on failure.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from a given URL and saves it locally.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the fallback path configuration after download.
